capabilities.target: hosts named by the calling agent's signed manifest net:dns entries
capabilities.justification: Resolves the requested host once so every answer can be checked for public routability before connecting (D18V V-R2).

capabilities.target: host:port pairs named by the calling agent's signed manifest net:connect entries, at a checked public address
capabilities.justification: Performs the agent's HTTPS request on its behalf, so a leased credential is injected inside the daemon and never reaches the agent (D18V).

justification: net.fetch is the host-mediated network operation: the daemon reaches only what an agent's signed manifest declares, over verified TLS to a checked public address. It has no filesystem, process, or environment authority.
